name: agent.ops_bridge
description: Agent 画布操作桥：只读 + 写(CAS/幂等) + 付费 propose 闸

name: qa.kids_gate
description: 幼儿动漫安全与节奏质检闸门

name: qa.kids_gate.extended
description: 幼儿动漫安全与节奏质检闸门 + §3.6 续作 QC（连续性/调色/转场/口语语言）

name: kids.review_sheet
description: 分镜审稿表网格 PNG 渲染（每格镜号/时长/台词/机位/景别/缩略图）

name: kids.render_local
description: 本地 CPU 渲染试点片（真实 ffmpeg，无付费 API，确定性可复现）。验收专用合成片（纯色底+镜号台词叠加），非生产渲染；生产混剪走 svfactory.render

name: kids.annotation_revision
description: 帧标注 → 确定性 ShotSpecPatch（§3.5 映射）

name: kids.story_gate
description: 幼儿故事闸门：6 节拍结构 + 因果转场比 + 单主题 + 固定角色一致性

name: kids.consistency_manifest
description: 幼儿一致性清单：schema 校验 + 与 ShotSpec 双向绑定

name: anatomy_explainer
description: 幼儿科普机械科普动画（动态等距小机器；mode=3d 为可转动的三维转台）

name: director_brief
description: 线路无关的 DirectorBrief 生成与自动补全。此 DirectorBrief 指 hevi.director_lens.brief.DirectorBrief（运动轨迹/物理/主光/BPM 拍点/禁止项等导演决策），不是 hevi.creative.director_brief 的 S1 哈希契约 DirectorBrief，也不是 hevi.season_planner.schemas.DirectorBrief（短剧导演阐述）

name: director_check
description: 全线通用的出片前自检闸门 (PPT同步/静止冻结/拍点对齐/声画对齐等)

name: motion_director
description: 动效导演层完整渲染 pipeline (导演版 vs 基线版 + 逐帧审片 HTML)

name: story_plan
description: 一句话自动补全叙事/分镜/时间线三层结构 StoryPlan

name: story_check
description: StoryPlan 结构自检门 (钩子、声画对齐、冗余、六项必填、闭环、幼儿安全)

name: take_select
description: 选段器 take_select：多候选 take 按帧评分与子区间选中

name: storyplan.critique
description: 剧本自审轮：挑剔观众+动画导演双重视角批判与自动修订

name: storyboard.preview_sheet
description: 分镜预览图：按镜头组生成漫画格分镜表（景别远中特、画面描述、台词，铅笔线淡彩风格）

name: transitions.storybook
description: 绘本转场：翻页、湿笔刷晕开、纸页撕裂、铅笔线自绘、水彩晕染

name: storybook.voice_align
description: 绘本配音对齐：按本地TTS实际时长重排镜头，双语字幕逐句对齐(<150ms)，旁白角色多音色语气，BGM避让留白

name: scene3d_asset_import
description: 导入并校验一件 GLB 资产（读三角面/顶点/贴图/骨骼/动画剪辑，返回清单记录）。

name: scene3d_template
description: 渲染幼儿向 3D 场景模板（小星球 / 小镇街道 / 游乐园一角，含环绕/推近/跟随相机预设）。

name: scene3d_character_anim
description: 渲染带骨骼 GLB 角色的行走镜头（AnimationMixer 确定性时间步驱动，肢体位移被实测校验）。

name: scene3d.planet_orbit
description: 漂浮 toon 小星球环绕镜头（小王子风格，CPU/SwiftShader 出片）。

name: scene3d.fox_wheat
description: 麦田里的小狐狸竖屏镜头，风吹草动 + 暖色 bloom。

name: scene3d.star_sea
description: 穿过星海推进镜头，星空粒子 + 大气雾 + bloom。

name: svfactory.montage
description: 素材文件夹确定性自动混剪（按时长选段、裁画幅、防连击、seed 去重）

name: svfactory.render
description: 本地 CPU 串行短片渲染（Piper TTS + 混剪 + libass 幼儿大字描边字幕 + kids_gate）。输入为脚本文本+素材目录的真实素材混剪，与 kids.render_local（manifest 驱动验收片）无关

name: handdraw.full
description: 幼儿向手绘动画；正 duration 为精确时长预览，0 为完整交付。

name: handdraw.storyboard
description: 仅生成分镜插画+口播稿（CPU 矢量插画），不渲染视频。

name: handdraw.narration
description: 整篇 CosyVoice/piper 旁白母带 + 时间戳对齐 JSON，不渲染画面。

name: handdraw.illustration
description: 单张 CPU 矢量风格插画 PNG（指定手绘风格）。

name: particle_text
description: 文字粒子化科普动画（确定性 Canvas 2D + 确定性 PRNG）

name: particle_science_scene
description: 儿童科普场景粒子动画（六层视差构图 + 语义配色）

name: parallax_layers
description: 六层视差构图系统（远景/中远/主体/前景/粒子/字幕层）

name: assets.library
description: 项目内可复用资产库（角色/场景/道具 CRUD 与音色绑定，集成 ReferenceStore）。

name: assets.extract
description: 从剧本自动抽取角色、场景与道具（复用 hevi.creative.layer4 ImportModule）。

name: image.multi_ref_compose
description: 多参考图融合与占位符解析（支持 capability_guard 与 provider 上限校验）。

name: style.project_snapshot
description: 项目级风格快照（生成不可变持久化版本快照ID，支持版本回溯）。

name: storyboard.shot_groups
description: 分镜镜头组拆分（复用 hevi.storyplan 模型，生成视频提示词与首尾帧约束）。

name: satori.title_card
description: Satori + resvg CPU 静态卡片/标题卡渲染

name: motion.review
description: 动画评审（review-animations）：按十项硬标准审查动画代码，输出 findings 表 + Block/Approve 结论。规则见 docs/rules/animation_taste.md。

name: motion.audit_plan
description: 全库动画审计（improve-animations）：扫描目录的动效代码，输出按影响/成本排序的审计表 + plans/ 下可执行的改进计划。

name: motion.perfcheck
description: 动画性能诊断（animation-performance）：按帧预算因果表定位掉帧原因（属性层级/线程/CSS 变量风暴/blur/will-change）。

name: explainer.script
description: 文章/资料转化为口播稿，支持自动分段、口语化重构、时长估算与版本增量编辑。能力线：纯 CPU 自含链（FFmpeg/PIL，无 Node/Remotion 依赖），与 Studio explainer 线（assembly+Remotion 生产核，供 6 条 Studio 线与 API）是两条独立链；本线供能力目录按名调用与 lanshu styled explainer。

name: explainer.visual_plan
description: 节奏驱动视觉规划：依据音频词级时间戳排镜，支持关键词高亮、配图卡片、流程图逐层展开、主讲人布局切换与转场。能力线：纯 CPU 自含链（FFmpeg/PIL，无 Node/Remotion 依赖），与 Studio explainer 线（assembly+Remotion 生产核，供 6 条 Studio 线与 API）是两条独立链；本线供能力目录按名调用与 lanshu styled explainer。

name: explainer.render
description: 解说视频快速低清预览帧与纯 CPU 本地 FFmpeg MP4 最终视频渲染。能力线：纯 CPU 自含链（FFmpeg/PIL，无 Node/Remotion 依赖），与 Studio explainer 线（assembly+Remotion 生产核，供 6 条 Studio 线与 API）是两条独立链；本线供能力目录按名调用与 lanshu styled explainer。

name: stickman.topic_scout
description: 对标频道数据少发高爆打分排序器（离线纯算法）

name: stickman.structure_clone
description: 五段心跳骨架时间比例自适应克隆与反抄袭生成器

name: stickman.proposal
description: 火柴人导演提案与状态机（草稿/批准权限隔离）

name: stickman.render_local
description: CPU-only 程序化火柴人本地渲染（白底黑线/彩色故事两套+双语字幕+微缩放转场）

name: stickman.flow_pack
description: Flow Omni Flash 720P 任务包导出器（画风锁定+积分台账）

name: stickman.flow_import
description: Flow 外部成品导入校验、双语字幕压制与微转场拼接器

name: audio.forced_align
description: Measured word-level {text, start_ms, end_ms} timestamps from real audio via ElevenLabs forced alignment (Monid). Use instead of LuxTTS estimated timings when millisecond accuracy matters (subtitle burn, word-level cuts). Result marks is_estimated=False.

name: image.gpt_generate
description: GPT-Image 2.5 text-to-image stills (Monid). Use for high-aesthetic studio scenes and character sheets when the local GPU route is unavailable.

name: image.gpt_edit
description: GPT-Image 2.5 reference-based edit from up to 16 images (Monid). The character-consistency workflow: same face/clothing/scene across poses and angles.

name: story.film_from_prompt
description: One-sentence-to-film orchestration: premise → story draft (hook, character profiles, beats) → GPT-Image character + scene stills → LuxTTS narration → measured word alignment → timed shots (first_frame/motion_prompt/duration) → HyperFrames film with gates, or a PixStag shot package for the live-action line. Stage evidence + costs land in the job dir (delivery.json).

name: audio.earshot_gate
description: Audio gate (earshot measure, model-free, local): true peak, integrated LUFS vs target, hard-clipping and silence checks. The picture-side counterpart is film_gate. Writes earshot_gate_report.json; qa['pass'] is the verdict. Use on final mixes / narration before delivery.

name: audio.sfx_render
description: Render one of earshot's 201 code-defined sound effects by id to wav (48 kHz). Fully local and offline: the bank is synthesis recipes, no samples and no model download. Use for UI clicks, whooshes, hits and stingers in code-animated films.

name: qa.export_gate
description: Unified pre-delivery export QA gate (local, offline): container/codecs (mov/mp4 + h264 + aac), resolution/aspect, fps, black-frame ratio (zerolines frame_stats, luma < 12, max 0.1), loudness/true-peak/clipping via earshot measure with audio.earshot_gate thresholds, A/V duration sync (<= 0.5 s), ending integrity (abrupt-cut warn, last-frame black warn) and optional subtitle presence. Writes export_qa_report.json; qa['verdict'] is pass|warn|fail and qa['pass'] is verdict != fail. Use on final exports before delivery.

name: assembly.beat_align
description: BGM beat alignment (librosa, local/offline): detect beat times in an audio file and, given shot durations, return per-seam xfade durations snapped to the nearest beat (base +/- max_shift). No beats -> fallback=true with uniform base durations, never a fake snap. Writes beat_align_report.json; qa carries beats/snapped/fallback.

name: video.pixstag_generate
description: PixStag v2 external video render (MiniMax-H3 / doubao-seedance, via https://pixstag.com). Live-action story films: hevi produces shot packages (first frame + motion prompt + duration) and this renders each shot to mp4. Needs PIXSTAG_API_KEY; billed in credits (720P=1/s).

name: video.hyperframes_styles
description: creator-style-kit style catalogue (18 styles): use to pick a 9:16 HyperFrames style by content type (id, Chinese/English name, best_for, essence, palette, motion grammar, hard rules). Writes styles_catalogue.json regenerated from the kit checkout.

name: video.hyperframes_styled_render
description: Apply a creator-style-kit style to a beats list and render a deterministic 1080x1920 HyperFrames video (fonts/palette/motion/CC0 cue kit from the style; seek-based Chromium capture). Use video.hyperframes_styles first when the style is undecided.

name: story.branch_forecast
description: Plot-line forecasting before writing: from the current story state (canon facts, characters, recent summaries, author intent) generate 2-5 isolated future branches, each with beats, key character decisions, estimated state changes, risks and an intent-match score (0-1), plus a lateral comparison table. Writes branches.json with the story-state hash for staleness detection. Generator is injectable (set_generator_fn wins); otherwise the default Monid gpt-4o-mini backend runs when MONID_API_KEY is available (per-call small fee), and without a key the deterministic local placeholder runs instead (no LLM, no network, no cost). qa['generator'] always names what ran.

name: story.branch_adopt
description: Adopt one forecasted branch into a plan file (branch_plan.json): stores the adopted branch, its story hash and the comparison table. The canon itself is never modified; a supplied canon_path is verified byte-identical before/after. Stale forecasts (story hash mismatch) are refused unless allow_stale is set.

name: text.style_extract
description: Deterministic statistical style profile of a sample text: sentence/paragraph length distributions, punctuation and function-word frequencies, modal-particle and tone ratios. Writes profile.json. Use as the first step of style transfer or to compare two authors' styles.

name: text.style_transfer
description: Rewrite text toward a style profile (from sample_text or a profile dict). The rewrite is performed by the injected backend (set_rewrite_fn) when one is installed, otherwise by the default Monid gpt-4o-mini backend (per-call small fee, same MONID_API_KEY as story.film_from_prompt); with neither available the render raises CapabilityError. Writes profile.json + rewritten.txt.

name: text.humanize
description: Deterministic de-AI polish for Chinese text: removes template clichés (值得注意的是/总而言之/…), applies colloquial swaps, splits over-long sentences and diversifies punctuation. Writes humanized.txt + humanize_report.json with per-category change counts.

name: story.foreshadow
description: Foreshadowing ledger for one work (file-based story bible). action=plant records a setup with its expected payoff window (expected_start..expected_end chapters); payoff/abandon move it through its lifecycle; list queries entries; check_overdue returns the alarm list of setups still open past their window at current_chapter. Use to keep long serials from dropping planted setups.

name: story.canon_check
description: Canon ledger + pre-writing consistency check for one work. action=add_fact confirms a fact (fact/subject/attribute/value/source_chapter/tags) into canon — a conflicting value for the same subject+attribute is rejected; action=list dumps canon; action=check compares a draft chapter's claims (subject/attribute/value list) against canon and reports contradictions (ok=false) before the chapter is written.

name: novel.create
description: Create a long-form serial novel from a creative brief (genre / protagonist / core conflict / chapter count / per-chapter target chars). Produces a file-based book directory: book.json with world setting, character profiles and a full chapter outline. LLM backend: an injected llm_fn (set_llm_fn) if installed, otherwise the default Monid gpt-4o-mini backend (per-call small fee, same MONID_API_KEY as story.film_from_prompt).

name: novel.write_chapter
description: Write one chapter of an existing book: pre-write analysis (chapter intent + previous-chapter summary + continuity facts) → draft → generation-side word-count governance (one expand round when >20% short, one shrink round when >20% over, never more) → chapter file on disk and book.json progress updated. LLM backend: injected llm_fn (set_llm_fn) or the default Monid gpt-4o-mini backend (per-call small fee).

name: novel.continue_work
description: Import an existing novel as plain text: split into chapters (第X章 / Chapter X markers), build the continuation context (last-chapter summary + character table in continuation.json), preserve the imported chapters on disk, then write the next chapter from the breakpoint through the same write_chapter path (with word-count governance). LLM backend: injected llm_fn (set_llm_fn) or the default Monid gpt-4o-mini backend (per-call small fee).

name: story.short_package
description: Short-story one-stop package: premise -> outline -> draft -> structured self-review (hook/conflict/ending checklist scores) -> blurb & selling points (title candidates, one-line pitch, synopsis) -> dedicated cover step (cover prompt always; cover.png via image.gpt_generate when available, otherwise prompt-only degradation noted in qa). All artifacts land in the job dir (package.json is the ledger).

name: text.translate_long
description: Long-text translation pipeline: paragraph-aware chunking (configurable per-chunk character ceiling, context overlap between adjacent chunks) -> per-chunk translation -> glossary consistency post-check (missing required target terms are reported as warnings) -> full translation plus segment-by-segment bilingual output (Markdown + JSON) and a translation report in the job dir. 文档级长文翻译（整篇文本→双语对照文档）；视频字幕段级译制走 hevi/production/media_workflows.video_localization_workflow（后端 voicepro_translate），两者勿混用。

name: play.world_init
description: Create a file-based interactive world (JSON state: setting, characters, flags/items, location, turn 0, opening choices). Refuses to overwrite an existing world file.

name: play.world_step
description: Advance an interactive world by one turn: supply an action (free text and/or choice_id) plus narrator output (narration, next choices, optional image_prompt hook and state_delta). State is validated and persisted atomically; turn count grows.

name: job.run_background
description: Run a registered capability in a background thread and guard it to completion: status lands in jobs/<job_id>/status.json, a completion notification is always written, and an optional webhook_url gets a best-effort POST.

name: job.status
description: Read one background job's status record (running/succeeded/failed, times, artifacts, error).

name: job.notifications
description: List recent background-job completion notifications from jobs/notifications.jsonl.

name: huobao.character_ref
description: 生成国风动漫风格的角色参考关键帧（CPU SD-Turbo，固定 seed 保证跨镜一致）。

name: huobao.scene_ref
description: 生成纯背景无人物场景参考关键帧（CPU SD-Turbo，固定 seed）。

name: huobao.shot
description: 渲染单镜头：解析 @角色/@场景/@道具 引用，生成关键帧并用 Piper 配音合成短视频段（CPU）。
